user.title: Connect Audiobookshelf
user.description: Enter an Audiobookshelf URL and API token. The token needs access to the library items and e-reader devices you want to use.

device.title: Choose default e-reader device
device.description: Audiobookshelf can send ebooks using its own e-reader and email settings. Configure SMTP and e-reader devices in Audiobookshelf, not Home Assistant. Choose "All devices" to send new books to every configured e-reader.

abort.already_configured: This Audiobookshelf account is already configured.

init.title: Audiobookshelf options
init.description: Automatic sending can use Audiobookshelf's own send-to-device feature. Optionally send notifications to your chosen targets when books arrive or are pushed to an e-reader.

data_description.notify_targets: Notify services or entities to alert (e.g. a phone's mobile app). Leave empty to disable notifications.
data_description.notify_title: Notification title used for every event.
data_description.notify_data: Extra notification payload as a JSON object. Applies to every event. String values may use the same placeholders as the message templates. Default sets tag to audiobookshelf and timeout to 3600.

send_ebook_to_device.name: Send ebook to device
send_ebook_to_device.description: Ask Audiobookshelf to send a library item's ebook to one of its configured e-reader devices.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: Book to send. Choose from the list of available ebooks, or enter a library item ID.

device_name.name: Device name
device_name.description: E-reader device. Choose from the list of configured devices, "All devices" to send to every one, or enter a name. If omitted, the integration's default device is used.

force.name: Force
force.description: Send even if the item was already marked as sent to this device.

send_item.name: Send item
send_item.description: Compatibility alias for Send ebook to device.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: Book to send. Choose from the list of available ebooks, or enter a library item ID.

device_name.name: Device name
device_name.description: E-reader device. Choose from the list of configured devices, "All devices" to send to every one, or enter a name. If omitted, the integration's default device is used.

force.name: Force
force.description: Send even if the item was already marked as sent to this device.

reset_sent_item.name: Reset sent item
reset_sent_item.description: Remove the sent marker for an Audiobookshelf item and e-reader device.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: Book whose sent marker to reset. Choose from the list, or enter a library item ID.

device_name.name: Device name
device_name.description: E-reader device. Choose from the list, "All devices" to reset every device's marker, or enter a name. If omitted, every device's marker is reset.

auth_failed.title: Audiobookshelf authentication failed
auth_failed.description: Audiobookshelf rejected the configured API token: {detail}. Reconfigure the integration with a valid token.

connectivity_failed.title: Audiobookshelf is not reachable
connectivity_failed.description: Home Assistant could not connect to Audiobookshelf: {detail}.
